page.content:
Slow-spreading plate boundary that splits the Atlantic floor.

How Mid-Atlantic Ridge connects

  • Character: Marie Tharp — Marie Tharp drew the rift valley that revealed the Mid-Atlantic Ridge as a spreading center.
  • Topic: Seafloor spreading — The Mid-Atlantic Ridge is the type locality of slow seafloor spreading.

What is Mid-Atlantic Ridge?

The Mid-Atlantic Ridge is the seafloor mountain chain Tharp drew with a central rift, the type example of a spreading ridge.

Key threads lead to Marie Tharp and Seafloor spreading.
